notes.title: DEV DIARY | September 24
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

You may have noticed a slower pace of updates for the game lately, so we wanted to share some news from the team and provide an update on the development of The Pioneers.

As we’ve mentioned before, our team’s situation is challenging. Despite the moderate success we enjoyed on Steam when we launched in Early Access last year, we’ve struggled to secure enough financial resources to hire the full team necessary to develop a game as ambitious as The Pioneers. Nonetheless, we’ve chosen to keep going, driven by hard work and determination. This decision, however, means we’re working with a small team and juggling multiple activities both within and outside the gaming industry—simply to make ends meet. We hope that one day we’ll be able to dedicate ourselves 100% to our passion, and we’re not giving up! But for now, we must accept that the game’s development is progressing more slowly than we had hoped. We sincerely thank those of you who have supported us by purchasing the game; your trust helps bring our vision to life.

We’re also aware of the design issues present in the current state of the game: core systems that are still too unstable, lack of content and replayability, and insufficient guidance for new players. We have a comprehensive plan to overhaul these aspects, rethinking them from the ground up. Creating a game as complex as The Pioneers is no easy task, and we’re still not entirely sure that the path we’re currently on is the best one. But we believe in it and are pouring all our energy into making it happen.

The next update is taking longer to arrive because it involves a deep rework of some core aspects of the game and how you’ll experience The Pioneers: the structure of the game, its pace and progression, management and micro-management, tutorialization... and all of this is being developed under particularly challenging conditions. We’re passionate gamers ourselves and often find ourselves in your shoes. So, we fully understand and share your impatience. Rest assured, we’re doing our best, and we have no intention of abandoning the creation we’ve already invested the last five years of our lives into.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding.

Supercube Team

In celebration of our participation in the Steam Endless Replayability Fest, we are happy to release a new regular update.

Here's what you can look forward to in Version 0.52. Have a nice fest!

[h3]LOCALIZATION[/h3]

To enhance the accessibility of our game for our international audience, we have decided to implement [b]23 new localizations[/b], in addition to the 8 already available.

These new languages are generated using "LocalAIze," our in-house tool built on a Large Language Model (LLM) architecture. As such, these translations may be imperfect. If you prefer to avoid encountering errors in the game's text, we recommend using English or one of the other seven languages directly managed by our development team.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #3 | DECISIONS
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

[h3]The entire team is incredibly proud of the work done on "Decisions," the 3rd major update for TPSD. You can check out all the update notes here, and please see the end of the post for a more personal and heartfelt message.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/7fa0491661ead7dd84091513339d19d3e93db8e4.png[/img]
[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]

[i]This 3rd major update brings tons of new gameplay features. As outlined in the roadmap, it focuses on decision-making: choose one type of victory over another, establish the strategy of the day and forego certain bonuses, make the best choice when an event occurs... Whether strategic or tactical, we hope all these decisions will make your games more intense and more unique.[/i]

[u]Main additions:[/u]
[list]
[*] Introduced a new [b]character[/b], Dinesh Khan, the Life Support Engineer.

[*] Added a new [b]skill[/b], "Telecommunication," strongly tied to machine use in the command center. This skill reflects your pioneers' proficiency with remote communication tools.

[*] Added a new [b]station module[/b]: the Command Center. Use it to contact Earth for assistance, plan your EVA (Extravehicular Activity) excursions, support your team remotely, and foresee threats with the weather station.

[*] New [b]victory condition[/b]: Rescue. OCTAL has you covered, dispatching a rescue shuttle after approximately 30 days. The question is, can you hold out until then?

[*] New feature: Pioneers' [b]Field of View[/b]. Terrain features become visible within a short range around your characters during EVA excursions.

[*] New feature: [b]Antennas[/b]. Most machines in the command center link to an antenna on the roof, which may fail during storms. This failure renders the connected machine inoperative, necessitating repairs.

[*] New feature: [b]Start Randomization[/b]. The initial pioneer can now emerge from any capsule, with the other two survivors placed randomly in other capsules. Initial loot is always positioned in front of the station to diversify the game's beginning.
[/list]
[u]Events system:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Daily meetings[/b]: At each day's start, crew members gather to propose strategies. You must select one, usually resulting in a buff for some or all crew members. Each pioneer can make unique suggestions.
[*] [b]Hazard events[/b]: Singular events such as spoiled rations or crew disputes can now occur.
[*] [b]Point of interest events[/b]: Linked to terrain features (e.g., caves, satellites) or randomly revealed by pioneers' field of view.
[*] [b]Contacting OCTAL[/b] or loved ones is also enhanced by the new event system.
[/list]
[u]Other additions/changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Redesigned [b]beacons [/b]with a triangulation system to uncover outdoor points of interest.
[*] Visual and gameplay improvements for [b]volcanic bombs[/b], now exploding on impact and potentially breaching station walls. This change aims to heighten their threat level in the mid to late game.
[*] Developed proprietary tools for creating events and buffs, introducing over [b]50 new buffs[/b] and an equal number of [b]events [/b](more to come).
[*] Introduced a new [b]personal item[/b] related to Dinesh.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=yUj35ozQF7w;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]LEVEL DESIGN[/h3]

[i]We've worked hard to incorporate your feedback on the level design, refining our workflow for enhanced precision and polish. We're also trying to give more identity to the different areas of the current map. Your ongoing feedback is invaluable as we continue refining the level design.[/i]

[u]Two new areas introduced:[/u]
[list]
[*] A zone of rocky plateaus, rich in rare earths, replaces the former sulfur zone. This area poses unique challenges, including permanent fog and a vertical layout with deep chasms.
[*] The sulfur marshes, situated further than the old sulfur zone, present a significant mid-game challenge. The visuals have been upgraded, incorporating the new unity water shader.
[/list]
[h3]UI & ERGONOMICS[/h3]

[i]In this update, we've undertaken a major overhaul of the upper area of the HUD. Nevertheless, there's still much to be done to improve the game's clarity and accessibility. This significant task will be addressed in an interim patch before the release of the fourth major update.[/i]

[h3]A Final Word Before You Dive Into the Game[/h3]

Some of you have recently shared your eagerness, and even your concerns, about the future of TPSD, noticing the absence of major updates on the horizon. We take this as encouragement! After all, facing pressure from our players is generally more welcome than their indifference. ;)

Your questions deserve an answer, and we're seizing this moment to share more about us and our situation.

The Pioneers is an extremely ambitious game that could easily engage a hundred people over several years and consume millions (or even tens of millions) of dollars in production costs. When we pitched the project to publishers capable of supporting such a budget, we were consistently reminded that this was our studio's first major game and the financial risk was too high. No one took the leap with us. So, we chose a different path to try and realize our dream nonetheless.

Our entire team (10 people) agreed to share part of the risk by becoming co-authors of the project, thus earning only from sales (if the game sells well, we can pay ourselves; if not, we keep hoping while eating pasta). To date, The Pioneers has sold around 15,000 units. That's great, placing the game in the top 10% of best-selling products on Steam. But as you might guess with a simple calculation, it's clearly not enough to ensure our stability, expand the team, and plan future projects.

We chose this path knowingly and have no regrets. However, it means that sometimes some of us need to take on additional work to make ends meet, or that we can't afford to hire QA or translation studios.

Making a living from video games is far from easy today. A tiny portion of the industry captures players' attention and spending, one that can invest millions in marketing campaigns, engage in sometimes questionable business practices, and prioritize profitability over quality. We are not one of those studios and never will be. With our modest means, energy, and passion, we simply strive to bring to life the game of our hearts, which embodies everything we love about our hobby, without treating players like fools.

Yes, what we do is imperfect and sometimes delayed. But know that we're doing our best and that, after all these years of hard work, we're already proud of the game we've produced. It's not going to stop anytime soon, and we're convinced it will find a deserving spot in your Steam libraries, whether before or after the end of its early access.

Regardless, even when times are tough, we're very happy and motivated. We hope you'll enjoy this update. We eagerly await your feedback. Have fun.

[b]The Supercube Team[/b]

[h3]We're thrilled to announce that the third major update for TPSD is on the horizon.[/h3]

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #2 | ROAD TRIP
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Pioneers,[/h1]

With this major update, the rover "The Bear" makes its debut in the game. This first vehicle marks a turning point in the way you approach your adventures on Io. Explore further and longer, protect yourselves from the main threats, carry more equipment, and unlock new unique actions... The rover comes with a plethora of new features and numerous contents added to existing systems. It lays the foundations for a new way of exploring and prepares for future game map overhauls.

This update has also been an opportunity for us to deliver an overall more enjoyable game to you. The road is still long, but we have taken your feedback into account to continue improving ergonomics and balancing in the game. Significant work has also been done to correct as many bugs as possible.

To be completely transparent with you, maintaining the stability of a game like The Pioneers is a gigantic technical challenge. With a growing number of innovative features, interconnected systems, and procedural algorithms that all affect the world, it is very easy to generate new bugs on previously functional systems. From the outset of the game's production, we knew that we would have to climb a mountain, and that's why we opted for early access. Rest assured that we are doing our utmost to detect and correct bugs. However, we are a very small team, and it is certain that we will never be able to resolve all the issues before each patch. You are not our QA testers, but if you come across a new bug, we would be grateful if you could [url=https://discord.gg/thepioneersgame]report it to us on Discord[/url]. We are generally very responsive in releasing hotfixes.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #1 | Player XP, traits, game modes, Twitch Extension and more...
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Pioneers,[/h1]

We hope all has been well for you. At Supercube, we are super proud to release the first major update for The Pioneers. According to the roadmap announcement, this is the first game changing patch from a serie of six that will lead us to the 1.0 release

[h3][i]Let's have a quick overview of what is new here[/i][/h3]

[h2]Difficulty settings[/h2]
Game setup now has options to adjust the mission's difficulty. Play with different parameters or use a preset to fit your skills and overall challenge. Just note that harder games lead to higher scores

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/7e2323e13a2a927fcb0b1c5379fd7e98d270a0ad.jpg[/img]

[h2]Player XP[/h2]
The end-game score has been changed to include the missions difficulty. You should now see a larger spread of scores between different players and runs. The score is also converted into player XP, to progress through player levels. For each level you gain, you unlock a unique reward that will offer you to replay the game in a different setting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/50c3b21d73fd3c6cbab2edbaec40c9fb4f0cca3d.png[/img]

[h2]Game modes[/h2]
Based on your player XP, you will unlock new game modes to choose from. At the moment, we have implemented two modes, but this system is going to evolve in the future to offer a lot of new scenarios and challenges. Here are the modes available now:

[b]Survivor mode:[/b] enjoy the vanilla experience of the game with only... one survivor.
[b]Apocalypse mode:[/b] start the game with an active volcano...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/d7b09276a50415d3b596dc898da2a1ab11b02be4.png[/img]

[h2]Traits[/h2]
Based on your player XP, you will also unlock personality traits to customize your characters. Before launching a mission, you can add positive and negative traits to your selected survivors. For each positive trait you must have a negative trait, but you can have more negative traits than positive overall. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/8224aee5bcd154c6a5e543489cc1cc482ceb559c.png[/img]

[h2]Characters[/h2]
You now have to unlock characters through the progression system if you want to select them at the beginning of a mission

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/b57fe0a506662d6458e1fc3ed3d888a7af1c7143.png[/img]

[h2]Twitch Extension[/h2]
We are very excited about the beta version of The Pioneers Twitch Extension (Chat Revenge).
We hope you will enjoy it as much as we had fun to design it. Do not hesitate to ping your favorite streamer to try it.

[h3]How does it work?[/h3]
In this game mode, you can influence the environment to ruin your streamers life and prevent them from achieving their survival goal

[h3]Community votes[/h3]
Each round lasts between 6 and 12 minutes. During this phase of the game, you can vote for the penalty you want to inflict on your streamer among the 6 random disasters proposed, using the interface of the extension. You can change your mind, but only your last vote is taken into account. The votes of the whole chat are counted and sorted by popularity at the top of the streamers screen

[h3]Subs/bits[/h3]
During each round, you can increase the difficulty of the game by using subs or bits. Each contribution raises the difficulty and triggers more penalties among those chosen by the community

[h3]End of each round[/h3]
At the end of the round, all the penalties are activated and the streamer faces the disasters that the chat has chosen.  The added difficulty from bits will expire, and a new round of suffering begins

[h3]Note[/h3]
If the difficulty level maxes out, extra subs/bits roll over into increasing the difficulty of the next round.
Of course, subs and bits work as usual and only go to the streamer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/fc8955165ef23aa44f70100554eea3bce8e1c45f.png[/img]

[h2]OTHER CHANGES (v 0.36.01)[/h2]

[*] Since many of you asked us to rework the end-game, seismic activity and heat system have been balanced to avoid soft-locking situations. You will now have more occasions to explore the map, even if the seismic activity has raised to a very difficult point

[i][h3]All the team thank your for your support and hope you will enjoy those additions. Do not hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/thepioneersgame]join us on Discord[/url] and share your feedback![/h3][/i]

notes.title: Launch week is ending | Patch 0.35 and hotfixes summary
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

Once again, all Supercube crew would like to thank you for the incredible support we received during this Early Access launch week.

Many of you have reported bugs, shared your feedback and save files with the team. This has helped us a lot in solving most of the annoying issues encountered in the game. We still have a lot of polishing to do, but we can now start thinking about the future. 

Expect regular updates from us. We will push weekly fixes and small features (+ many surprises) before we release the first major update of Q1.
This one focuses on replayability, thanks to new settings, modes and a game+ system. Stay tuned for more information.

Before enjoying the new build, check out the latest patch notes (v0.35) and a summary of all the hotifxes already released.

Thank you Pioneers. See you on Io!

notes.title: The Pioneers is out now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

After four years of hard work, we are so excited to announce that our major title The Pioneers: Surviving Desolation is ready to begin its Early Access journey.

From the first draft of the idea to this release, a lot has happened. We've made tons of design choices that are only now revealing their potential, we've won a few awards and grants, the team has grown to 10 people, some of us have had children and grew them... The Pioneers is already an important part of our lives and we are forever bound to this amazing project.

[i]But we also know that this is only the beginning...[/i]

[previewyoutube=TIuCNgtSDks;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What to expect during Early Access?[/h3]

The main game systems are 100% working and we are now able to deploy a lot of content on a regular basis. Basically, expect more of everything to come. More characters, more station modules, more equipment, more terrain events, more strategic options...

To give our vision a good readability, we have decided to divide our roadmap into major slices. Each of these will be thematically based, will expand gameplay possibilities and should give you a good reason to start a new mission.


[h3]Our Roadmap[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215422/75e95919fb3f1459ea8fa2374768849ba47b70af.png[/img]

We have a pretty clear vision of what we want to achieve with The Pioneers. But we've left plenty of room for player feedback. Through weekly playtest and daily discussions on our Discord, we will be implementing many features and adjustments to meet the needs and ideas of the community.


[h3]A big thank you[/h3]

Finally, we wanted to thank all the amazing people we met during the last years. There is still a long way to go, but we are grateful to all those who made this project even possible. Backers, dev friends, content creators, our families, early testers and supporters... You made our dream come true.


[h3]Let's take off[/h3]

To reward your trust, you will get 15% off for a limited time. So come on board now and take a seat aside us in The Pioneers Early Access. We hope you'll enjoy the trip!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734390/The_Pioneers_Surviving_Desolation/

notes.title: Steam demo is out !
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Since the first version of the demo is out, we gathered all your precious feedback and worked hard on improving your game experience. 
Here is the latest version of the demo build, now downloadable on Steam.
Get ready for new features and a huge amount of fixes. See the changelog for details.
We count on you to skyrocket downloads and wishlists stats. It will help us a lot, especially since we are looking for funds to rush the production phase 😉

To celebrate this particular occasion, we reworked the branding of the game and the Steam page with new artworks and logo. Tell us if you like it! 


[b]CHANGELOG 1.12.12[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] Save system is live! No need to rush your games from now. Just save and load them later ;)
[*] The first piece of equipment is ready to use: beacons. Install them when you are exploring the area to extend your camera’s range and highlight specific zones
[*] A second piece of equipment is ready to use: ziplines. Equip the zipline to cross rifts and cliffs
[*] A third piece of equipment is ready to use: explosives. Explosives offer you the capability to destroy rocks that could block your way through some areas of the map
[*] New character action: climb. Without a zipline, you can try to climb riffs, even if it is more risky
[*] New feature to collect resources: probe scavenging. A few satellites that have crashed on Io can be scavenged to gather construction material
[*] Station production engines can now be equipped with automation upgrades. Let the robotized arm collect resources for you and chill
[*] It is now possible to eat together in the restaurant. A new set of 3D assets and animations have been implemented for this action
[*] Crates and loots are more diversified and their placement has been reworked.
[*] Some future and not yet functional features are showcased in the demo build to help you embrace the vision of The Pioneers
[/list]
[b]Ergonomics[/b]

[list]
[*] A new way to use airlocks and doors has been implemented. They now automatically open when a pioneer approaches. An action is also available to keep the doors open
[*] The station elevator is now easier to use. It can embark all your characters instead of one
[*] Camera has been reworked to offer a smoother navigation experience. It should now be less jumpy when moving above rugged terrain
[*] A new tooltip system is now live and will be progressively extended to welcome more information in a more readable way
[*] Roofs work a lot better when you stand inside and outside the station.
[*] New tutorial steps to guide through the new features
[/list]
[b]Optimization[/b]

[list]
[*] Game performance is highly increased for small configurations. This update should provide a 10 to 20 FPS boost to players
[*] Graphic settings are now available in the main menu. You can choose between presets of custom configuration according to your hardware performance
[*] A link to our bug report and feedback platform is available in the main menu and in the game scene. Do not hesitate to use it. It helps us a lot!
[/list]
[b]Localization[/b]

[list]
[*] New localized strings and fixes on english, french and spanish languages
[/list]
[b]Branding[/b]

[list]
[*] The Pioneers has a new look (cover, Steam page, logo…) to reflect in a better way the actual mood and future of the game
[/list]
[b]Minor changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Construction robot Maggie has now a better look thanks to new lights, animations. Construction visual effect has also been reworked to be more realistic
[*] Animations, VFX and SFX has been added to various character actions
[*] New welcome message in the main menu
[*] A temporary artwork is now replacing missing images in various events
[*] A pioneer lifepod can now be found on the map
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix of a visual bug that generated glitches on an iced terrain
[*] Fix of a major bug that changed character placement when closing a door
[*] Fix of a major bug that impacted multiple pathfinding issues
[*] Fix of a bug on “sleep” action. Characters no longer wake up when you ask them to sleep
[*] Fix of a bug that generates breakdowns on an already broken Maggie during storms
[*] Fix of a major bug that sometimes prevented players to launch a new game
[*] Fix of a bug that sometimes prevented players to end the game even if they had lost their three pioneers
[*] Characters should no longer be stunned forever on certain failed actions
[*] Fix of bugs that swapped portraits and voice lines after a character’s death
[*] Fix a many bugs that let the players trigger actions even if their character was far from the interaction area
[*] Fix of a bug that impacted soundtrack rotation from dramatic to calm ambient
[*] Fix a many collider bugs between characters and other game assets
[*] Fix of various bugs in the user interface that prevented players to see or click on some buttons
[*] Fix of a bug that sometimes prevented players to choose their favorite language in the main menu
[*] Fix of various visual and audio bugs
[*] Fix and tweaks on displayed information and tooltips
[/list]
